subject: world_language
concept: Interpreting and summarizing spoken content in real time (basic consecutive interpretation practice) between the target language and native language
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student practices short segment-by-segment interpretation between a spoken target-language passage and their native language
exercise.abstract: Student accurately interprets or summarizes a short spoken passage between the target language and their native language

assessment.mastery_threshold: interpretation/summary preserves the original meaning accurately, allowing for natural paraphrase
misconception_flags: interpretation introduces meaning not present in the original or omits a key point

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
